releaseNotes: Fix: close the offline setup through its actual DOM element; the setup controller object is no longer passed to remove().

Previously verified installations are re-audited against the current offline asset manifest and automatically retained when every file passes byte-length and SHA-256 checks, including after this update.
Verified cached files are reused across this release; the full offline package is not downloaded again when the files are already present.
Retry setup now reruns the setup check correctly and reports local setup failures without mislabeling them as network-only errors.
